svg.text: Pico W + BTT TMC2226 (Y + dual Z)
Three-driver wiring for Y, Z-left, and Z-right.
Driver1 (TMC1): reserved/disconnected while live Y uses the TB6600 interface.
Live TB6600 Y interface connector: STEP=GPIO0, DIR=GPIO1, EN=GPIO2, GND=PICO_GND_03.
Heatbed boost SSR: SSR_OUT=GPIO20 with Pico logic ground.
Heatbed thermistor: SIGNAL=GPIO26_ADC0, GND=AGND, 4.7k pull-up REF-to-SIGNAL.
Heatbed thermistor damping: 100uF SIGNAL-to-GND; electrolytic positive to SIGNAL, negative to AGND/GND.
